newsitem.title: USA: Kelley Oil closes reserves acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Kelley Oil closes reserves acquisition.

text.p: Kelley Oil & Gas Corp said that effective July 1, it will have closed the acquisition and taken ownership of undeveloped reserves in four fields in the Vacherie Salt Dome area of north Louisiana.
The company said the acquisition is estimated to increase proved reserves by at least 30 billion cubic feet equivalent.

Kelley's working interests in these Kelley operated properties will increase from an average of about 35 percent to about 55 percent, the company said. Consideration paid for the interests, which was financed through its bank revolving credit facility, is $10 million.
A Kelley spokesperson later said that the properties were acquired from other working interest owners in the area, but declined to specify particular companies.
